eccIdInstructions.label: Enter ECC ID
eccIdInstructions.description: Please enter a valid serial code matching one of the following patterns:
patterns: T- followed by 3 or 4 digits, optionally ending with Y and a letter C-Z (e.g., T-1234YC)
H- optionally followed by K, L, M, N, followed by 3 digits (e.g., HK-123)
2 digits followed by a letter C-Z, followed by 3 digits (e.g., 23C123)
